qualification.details: Qualification: Must have worked for at least 2 years at the Centre under Central Staffing Scheme; Experience in Trade, Commerce, Industry and allied sectors either at the Centre or in the State Government/Cadre; Clear from vigilance angle; Not debarred from Central deputation; At least 'Very Good' service record; At least one batch below the batch of officers currently empanelled to hold the post of Joint Secretary or equivalent with the Central Government Experience: Experience in Trade, Commerce, Industry and allied sectors either at the Centre or in the State Government/Cadre; at least 2 years at the Centre under Central Staffing Scheme Age limit: Maximum 54 years | Other conditions: | Officer must be clear from vigilance angle Officer should have at least 'Very Good' service record Cooling Off period after a previous deputation stint, if any, must be complete Officer must be eligible to be appointed on Central Deputation Officer should be at least one batch below officers currently empanelled for Joint Secretary or equivalent at the Centre | Desirable: | Exposure to International negotiations in Trade, Commerce, Industry and allied sector Preference to officers with 'Outstanding' service record with a grading of 9 & above

salary_details.pay_scale: First Secretary at Level-12 / Counsellor at Level-13

how_to_apply: The post is circulated among eligible officers by State Governments/UTs and Ministries/Departments.
Names of willing and eligible officers who can be spared are forwarded/e-mailed to DoPT at [email protected].
Use the prescribed format attached to the circular.
Attach Cadre clearance, Vigilance clearance, Detailed Bio-data and APAR Dossier/certified APAR grading for the last five years.
Officers on Central Staffing Scheme deputation: forward with approval of the Minister-in-Charge and Cadre Clearance from Parent Cadre/Organization.
Applications must reach the Department by 17 December 2026.
important_instructions: The Competent Authority may relax any of the conditions of eligibility in deserving cases Columns 1-13 of the format are filled by the applicant; columns 14-16 by the Ministry/Department/CCA concerned Cadre Clearance for officers on Central Staffing Scheme deputation must be issued by their Parent Cadre/Organization only

content_sections.heading: DoPT First Secretary (Level-12)/ Counsellor (Level-13) Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.department_of_personnel_and_training_min: First Secretary at Level-12 / Counsellor at Level-13
Permanent Mission of India (PMI), World Trade Organization (WTO), Geneva

Serving officers with at least 2 years at the Centre under the Central Staffing Scheme and experience in Trade, Commerce, Industry and allied sectors at the Centre or in the State Government/Cadre; at least 'Very Good' service record; clear from vigilance angle
Department of Personnel and Training, Kartavya Bhawan-3, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: DoPT Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 4/37/2026-FA(UN) gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DoPT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Must have worked for at least 2 years at the Centre under Central Staffing Scheme; Experience in Trade, Commerce, Industry and allied sectors either at the Centre or in the State Government/Cadre; Clear from vigilance angle; Not debarred from Central deputation; At least 'Very Good' service record; At least one batch below the batch of officers currently empanelled to hold the post of Joint Secretary or equivalent with the Central Government Experience: Experience in Trade, Commerce, Industry and allied sectors either at the Centre or in the State Government/Cadre; at least 2 years at the Centre under Central Staffing Scheme Age limit: Maximum 54 years Other conditions: Officer must be clear from vigilance angle Officer should have at least 'Very Good' service record Cooling Off period after a previous deputation stint, if any, must be complete Officer must be eligible to be appointed on Central Deputation Officer should be at least one batch below officers currently empanelled for Joint Secretary or equivalent at the Centre Desirable: Exposure to International negotiations in Trade, Commerce, Industry and allied sector Preference to officers with 'Outstanding' service record with a grading of 9 & above

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DoPT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Officers debarred from Central deputation Officers posted earlier on an assignment in a foreign/captive post of the GoI Officers nominated for foreign training, or currently on training or foreign assignment Officers on study leave or long leave

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay is based on Level-12 or Level-13 of the pay matrix. Post to be filled for a period of three (3) years under the Department of Commerce Present incumbent's approved tenure runs up to 17 June 2027

rows.event: Last Date for Receipt of Applications

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed brief format Cadre clearance Vigilance clearance Detailed Bio-data APAR Dossier/certified APAR grading for the last five (5) years Approval of the Minister-in-Charge, for officers currently on deputation under Central Staffing Scheme

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DoPT Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: The post is circulated among eligible officers by State Governments/UTs and Ministries/Departments. Names of willing and eligible officers who can be spared are forwarded/e-mailed to DoPT at [email protected] . Use the prescribed format attached to the circular. Attach Cadre clearance, Vigilance clearance, Detailed Bio-data and APAR Dossier/certified APAR grading for the last five years. Officers on Central Staffing Scheme deputation: forward with approval of the Minister-in-Charge and Cadre Clearance from Parent Cadre/Organization. Applications must reach the Department by 17 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: The Competent Authority may relax any of the conditions of eligibility in deserving cases Columns 1-13 of the format are filled by the applicant; columns 14-16 by the Ministry/Department/CCA concerned Cadre Clearance for officers on Central Staffing Scheme deputation must be issued by their Parent Cadre/Organization only

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DoPT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DoPT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for First Secretary (Level-12)/ Counsellor (Level-13).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DoPT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 17 December 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 54 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: First Secretary at Level-12 / Counsellor at Level-13.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Serving officers with at least 2 years at the Centre under the Central Staffing Scheme and experience in Trade, Commerce, Industry and allied sectors at the Centre or in the State Government/Cadre; at least 'Very Good' service record; clear from vigilance angle.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Officer must be clear from vigilance angle. Officer should have at least 'Very Good' service record. Cooling Off period after a previous deputation stint, if any, must be complete. Officer must be eligible to be appointed on Central Deputation.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers debarred from Central deputation. Officers posted earlier on an assignment in a foreign/captive post of the GoI. Officers nominated for foreign training, or currently on training or foreign assignment. Officers on study leave or long leave.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post to be filled for a period of three (3) years under the Department of Commerce. Present incumbent's approved tenure runs up to 17 June 2027.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Permanent Mission of India (PMI), World Trade Organization (WTO), Geneva.
